req.title: Redirect count boundary
req.statement: The system shall accept /redirect/<n> with n in the range 1..30 inclusive and reject values above.

doc.reasoning: The violation is test[2] (test_redirect_n31_above_upper_boundary_rejected) which has kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. The rule requires that negative kind tests use heuristic=NEG, not BVA. The fix is to change heuristic from BVA to NEG for that test. n=31 is the first value above the valid range and is being tested as a rejection case, which is correctly a NEG heuristic (out-of-partition invalid input). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_lower_boundary_accepted
preconditions: n=1 is the minimum valid redirect count
expected: HTTP 200 response after following the single redirect
Response body contains 'url' key from /get endpoint
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=1 is lower boundary of valid range [1..30]
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=True)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data is not None
assert 'url' in data

tests.name: test_redirect_n31_above_upper_boundary_rejected
preconditions: n=31 is the first value above the valid range
expected: HTTP 4xx response (client error) indicating rejection of n=31
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=31 exceeds maximum of 30; system shall reject it
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/31', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code >= 400
assert r.status_code < 500

tests.name: test_redirect_n0_below_lower_boundary_rejected
preconditions: n=0 is below the minimum valid value of 1
expected: HTTP 5xx response because assert n > 0 fails in source, or HTTP 4xx client error
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=0 violates assert n > 0 in redirect_n_times; must not return 2xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 302
assert r.status_code >= 400

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_initial_response_is_redirect
expected: HTTP 302 response with Location header pointing to /get
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: state transition from redirect to final endpoint; n=1 must produce exactly one 302
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/get' in location

tests.name: test_redirect_n2_chains_correctly
actions: GET /redirect/2 without following redirects to check first hop
GET /redirect/2 with follow_redirects=True to check final result
expected: First response is 302 with Location pointing to /redirect/1
Final response after following all redirects is 200 with JSON body containing 'url'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: decision table — n>1 uses _redirect helper; n=1 goes directly to /get
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r1 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
assert r1.status_code == 302
location = r1.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/redirect/1' in location

r2 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=True)
assert r2.status_code == 200
data = r2.get_json()
assert data is not None
assert 'url' in data
